product_metadata.title: Yaheetech Industrial & Scientific TV Stand for TVs up to 55 Inch, Small Entertainment Center TV Table for 55 inch TV, Media Console Table with Storage Shelf for Living Room Bedroom Gray
features: Multiple uses: This wooden TV table widely befits TV, plasma, DVDs, LCDs, video game players, etc. The digital receivers, blue-rays, gaming consoles, and some other accessories can also be put on the lower open shelf for your convenience.

Versatile: Our rustic brown TV table is versatile for many occasions, such as bedroom, living room, reception room, etc. You can also put it in your study or for commercial use. The TV bench features a lower open shelf and a small shelf at the side and a tabletop, which allows you to store and display like books, magazines, mugs, cups, electronic devices, and so on.
Unique style: This TV/coffee table boast a rustic brown appearance and unique shape. Industrial style matching metal frame, this TV stand will add more beauty and special to your place.

Meet your storage needs: This coffee table provides a spacious tabletop for living room supplies. It can store daily necessities, office supplies, books, magazines, mugs, cups, electronic devices, and other things. A lower open shelf and a small shelf at the side provide extra space for storing magazines and books. Size and shape are suitable for an entryway table, hallway table, entry table, and sofa table.

Easy assembly: This TV stand requires some simple instruction, but do not worry about it. We offer illustrated instructions and all necessary fittings in the package. You can put them together following the instructions. If you have any problems and questions, please contact our customer service for further assistance.
